name: Continuum
description: Innovation, rebellion, and raw momentum. Continuum is chaotic, experimental, and edgy. It’s the proving ground for newer wrestlers and the home of the Intertemporal and Extreme divisions. Think of it as the collision point of chaos and evolution.

name: Timeless
description: Classic prestige and grand rivalries. Timeless is your flagship show, focused on legacy, honor, and intergenerational conflict. This is where main-event feuds are born and wrestling tradition is sacred — even when it's broken.

name: All Time Rumble
description: Massive battle royal across eras. Winner gets guaranteed shot at the ATW World Title.
